notes.title: Patch 0.3.0 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – Version 0.3.0
⚔️ New Feature: Equipment System!
We’ve introduced a brand-new Equipment System to Rosk! Players can now find, equip, and manage gear to enhance their dungeon runs. This includes:

 New Gear Drops: Bosses now drop powerful equipment to boost your abilities.
 Green-Tier Gear: A fresh set of green gear has been added, providing early progression options.
 Inventory & Item Management: Players can now equip, delete, and manage items seamlessly.

🛠️ Major Fixes & Improvements
Gameplay & Combat

 Boss AI Fixes: Resolved an issue where bosses would break due to re-evaluating HP on attack.
 Spell Bar Sync: Fixed spell bar desync issues.
 M.A.N.A. Vent: New class mechanic added to Spell-Slingers! Keep an eye on your heat bar!
 M.A.N.A. Vent Requirement: Now properly requires 75 heat to cast.
 M.A.N.A. Overcharge Decay: Mana overcharge now decays as intended.
 Bat Projectile Fix: Corrected bat enemy projectile behavior.
 Thorny Vines Hitbox Adjusted: Improved hit detection for easier targeting.
 Devon Buffed: Increased Devon’s health to make the fight more challenging.
 World & UI Fixes
 Dungeon Finder UI: Fixed an issue preventing clicks after completing a dungeon.

Minimap Adjustments:

 Player icon is no longer a white square.
 Removed duplicate player icons.

Sho Gar Fixes:

 Gate placement corrected.
 Sho Gar tree talking head now displays properly.

Lysandra Cutscene:

 No longer spawns before the cutscene.
 Fixed incorrect stopping position.

Animations & Effects

 Enemy Death Animations: Fixed enemies not playing their death animations before shrinking.
 Devon’s Death Animation: Now triggers correctly.
 Bandit Animations: Bandits now properly play their animations.
 NPC Click Reactions: NPCs now emote properly when clicked.

Character & Equipment Fixes

 Male Gladiator Equipment: Fixed an issue where his sword would equip on the floor.
 Login Character Gun Issue: Fixed Spell-Slingers not appearing with their weapon on login.
 New Item & Character Deletion Functions: Players can now delete unwanted items and characters.

Options & Menus

 Options Menu Fixes: Settings now function properly in builds.
 Video & Audio Options: Fixed issues preventing video and audio settings from saving.

Miscellaneous Fixes
Dialogue & Cutscene Fixes:

 Fixed “Miss Exposition” dialogue issues.
 Devon’s dialogue has been improved for clarity.

Map & Navigation:

 Players can no longer get stuck in pots.
 Fixed UI overlapping when searching for a server.
